targets.title: A bad taste in the mouth: Gustatory disgust influences moral judgment
targets.evidence_quote: This paper presents results from a multi-lab replication of an experiment suggesting that gustatory disgust (i.e., taste perception) can make moral judgments harsher (Eskine, Kacinik, & Prinz, 2011).
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, we found little to no support for Eskine and colleagues’ (2011) conclusions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors state an overall verdict of little to no support for the target conclusions, overriding isolated positive contrasts.
